import json, os, re, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT, read_json, write_json, file_sha256, machine_id, utc_now

original=ROOT/'runtime/low-v30-status-progress-published-20261027.json'
prior=read_json(original)
assert prior['status']=='waiting_for_publication_lock'
checkpoint=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/v30-status-delivery-checkpoint-20261028.json')
lock=ROOT/'runtime/production-publish.lock'
initial_lock=lock.read_text(encoding='utf-8') if lock.exists() else None
start=utc_now();deadline=time.monotonic()+1200
while lock.exists():
    assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'Live publication lock did not release within bounded wait; no lock deletion or Git mutation.'
    time.sleep(10)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
assert all(file_sha256(ROOT/p)==v for p,v in checkpoint['expected_sha256'].items())
base=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
audit=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261028-v30-static-live-lock-wait.json'
assert not audit.exists()
write_json(audit,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'new_wait_started_at_utc':start,'lock_release_observed_at_utc':utc_now(),
                  'original_exact_receipt_utf8':original.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),'original_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(original),
                  'actual_previous_terminal_result':'exit1: TimeoutError: Existing publisher retains lock; inspect owner',
                  'initial_foreign_lock_exact_utf8':initial_lock,'new_primary_base':base,
                  'scope':'Previous static publisher exited before acquiring the global lock or mutating Git. Waited for the actual other publisher to release its lock without deleting it. A distinct finite static publisher rechecks exact same28 task file SHAs and stages only those files plus this immutable failure record. No image call, canonical workfile replacement or unrelated staging.',
                  'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
paths=checkpoint['paths']+[audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()]
expected={p:file_sha256(ROOT/p) for p in paths}
code=(ROOT/'runtime/publish-v30-status-progress-20261028.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
code=code.replace('low-v30-status-progress','low-v30-status-lock-retry1').replace('low-v30-status-private-rebase-adoption','low-v30-lock-retry1-private-rebase-adoption')
code=re.sub(r"^base='[0-9a-f]+'",lambda m:'base='+repr(base),code,flags=re.M)
code=re.sub(r'^paths=.*$',lambda m:'paths='+repr(paths),code,flags=re.M)
code=re.sub(r'^expected=.*$',lambda m:'expected='+repr(expected),code,flags=re.M)
target=ROOT/'runtime/publish-v30-static-lock-retry1-20261028.py'
assert not target.exists()
compile(code,str(target),'exec')
target.write_text(code,encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-u','-X','utf8',str(target)],cwd=ROOT,timeout=1800)
assert result.returncode==0,'Inspect actual new publisher receipt before another attempt.'
